title: Paint
definition: Painting is the process of filling in pixels. It involves drawing text, colors, images, borders, and shadows. Painting is typically done on multiple 'layers'.
simpleExplanation: Painting is taking a digital paintbrush and coloring in the boxes that were calculated during the Layout phase.
